defects.source_says: The held 19 FR 7925 text (and the 1989 Codification) of section 11 reads 'The Administrator shall, after consultation with the executive agencies concerned and with due regard to their program activities, issue such supplementary regulations ...'. It names no consultation with the Director of the Bureau of the Budget. The claim's own original_operative_text for the clause shows the same wording, so the judgment_reason misstates the clause it decides.
